elections.quote: Regardless, an R running in a Trump +15 district trying to distance himself from Trump is a fascinating political signal.
It probably depends on how bad his electoral losses become. I don't think Rs will abandon him over bad poll numbers, but they might over actual election results.

Even if Rs start trying to cut ties with Trump, is that really possible in the year 2026? How many people still view the Republican Party as something more than an extension of the Trump cult of personality at this point?
